reason_for_decision: Missing full public mask/RGB frames prevents an unchanged-input controlled training comparison. User requested reporting feasibility before new collection.

minimal_first_step.type: physical replay of2existing training roots, not new scene sampling
minimal_first_step.source: Original reset parameters and the recorded low-level action sequence, including original settling. No intermediate GT state injection.
minimal_first_step.write: Save every actual public RGB/depth/mask/robot/calibration frame separately from private audit. Retain real short states and all outcomes.
minimal_first_step.validation: Compare replay action sequence, per-step robot/object state, contact labels, and original saved RGB endpoints. Stop on material divergence; do not silently call reconstructed/synthetic masks recorded data.
minimal_first_step.resource_estimate: About600control frames total; at prior per-public-frame file size roughly0.10GB. This is an estimate, not a new run.

conditional_small_extension_if_recovery_.training: Recover the12 existing A/B supplement grasp roots;12effective hard roots, including9notpreviouslyexported. Existing train roots are not counted as new independent roots.
conditional_small_extension_if_recovery_.development: Use a small fresh C root list, e.g.6 roots covering3colours x2drawer settings, frozen before collection; old C remains historical regression only. Do not relabel prior D/test acceptance as fresh validation.
conditional_small_extension_if_recovery_.maximum_scope: 12training replays(including2pilot)+6fresh C trajectories if separately decided, not432attempts or299rootcertification.
conditional_small_extension_if_recovery_.comparison: Keep675395parameter baseline reader, frozenDINO, normalization, controller, trainingbudget and jointcalibration fixed. Same-root equal-count hard-vsordinary negatives, same positive/background supervision. Pre-register exact ordinary-control availability and missingness after recovery.
conditional_small_extension_if_recovery_.control_confound: Existing closed-empty near negatives typically have nearzero aperture and~60mmTCPdistance; open near negatives differ in command/aperture. Thus this tests training coverage of a difficult state bundle, not an isolated effect of support with all other physics identical.
conditional_small_extension_if_recovery_.decision_metric: Root-level directional evidence on fresh C held errors/recall/UNKNOWN plus existing held,in/open regression; do not equate a tiny threshold pass with proof.
